text:
Type: multicolor striped low-pile rug
Use: adding color to a floor; living room, children's room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, retro, bohemian
Materials: short soft cut pile, thin bound edge
Colors: black, sky blue, yellow, coral orange, green, grey, pink, red
Shape: rectangle in wide horizontal color bands, flat soft surface, medium size, bold graphic stripes
Feel: playful, vibrant, energetic
Goes with: white walls, grey or white sofas, light wood, colorful accents; eclectic, modern or kids' rooms

product.name: RANDERUP
product.description: Durable, stain resistant and easy to care for since the rug is made of synthetic fibres.
